openai:gpt-5.2.task_description: A robot arm must pick up a block from the table and place it at a floating target position.
openai:gpt-5.2.explanation: At the midpoint the gripper should have been closing while moving the grasped block toward the target (forward/right and down) instead of drifting away without securing it.

judge.verdict: The proposed correction moves the gripper directly toward the target while closing to secure the block, which is physically plausible and clearly closes the goal gap.

anthropic:claude-opus-4-7.task_description: A robot arm must pick up a block from the table and place it at a floating target position.
anthropic:claude-opus-4-7.explanation: At the midpoint the gripper had retracted upward and away instead of descending onto the block, so it should have moved down and toward the block while closing the gripper to grasp it.

judge.verdict: The proposed correction moves the gripper toward the block and target within workspace/action limits and provides a clear, actionable descent-and-grasp strategy.
